posts.name: SUDHEE RAM
posts.cooked:
@sayan

Respected sir/madam, Through this post i want to inform you that during the duration of the OPPE conducted yesterday the VM lagged a lot , and this happened multiple times. It also rebooted multiple times and when i was attempting a question in vi editor it suddenly rebooted and then i could not work on that file anymore( as i could not recover that file).

Sometimes, even even though the script was passing all the test cases(both public and private) it was showing submission failed. I also could not understand whether or not green text and red text meant actual output and desired output and further clarification on this would be very helpful. During the exam many students like myself faced these problems.

Therefore, I humbly and respectfully ask the exam team to consider conducting another OPPE exam after addressing the above issues.

posts.name: Loga
posts.cooked:
I am writing to share the difficulties I faced during the System Commands OPPE held on 16 August (7–9pm) and to request kind consideration for a rescheduled attempt.

The OPPE virtual machine was extremely unresponsive, with every command and input taking several seconds to register. Each time I tried to evaluate my script, the system would freeze for long periods, often close to a minute. Even when the evaluation script did run, the outputs were inconsistent—I sometimes got different results on the same file. It also seemed that errors in the evaluation process prevented proper submission of the public and private test cases, and I lost a lot of time just trying to submit solutions that I had solved correctly.

In addition, the connection to the VM was terminated multiple times, which caused unnecessary setbacks. On top of this, I was also caught off guard by the absence of cheat sheets. A course TA had previously mentioned that cheat sheets would be available, so I was under the impression that they would be provided. Not receiving them, without prior clarification, made it difficult to quickly confirm syntax during the exam.

Because of these challenges, I feel that my performance did not reflect my preparation. I therefore kindly request that an opportunity be provided to attempt the OPPE again under more stable conditions, for all students who may have faced similar issues.

Thank you for your understanding.
